summary_en: 300,000 shares (5.2% of S/O ex-treasury) authorized for acquisition at ¥100.0M upper limit. Open-market purchase on TSE Growth Market between 18 Jun and 31 Jul 2026. Rationale: shareholder return enhancement and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice regarding the determination of matters related to the acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: TalentX Inc. announced on 17 June 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 300,000 shares of its common stock pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The aggregate acquisition amount is capped at ¥100,000,000. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market between 18 June and 31 July 2026. The 300,000 shares represent 5.2% of the 5,764,200 shares outstanding (excluding treasury) as of 31 March 2026. The board cited enhanced shareholder returns and improved capital efficiency, along with enabling flexible capital management, as the rationale for the program.
